create_omol_reducer: create an OMolReducer instance with a benchmark name and optional evaluator function
join_results_gz_json: join results from multiple gzip compressed JSON files into a single dictionary
save_results_gz_json: save benchmark results to a gzip compressed JSON file in the results directory
compute_metrics_evaluator: compute benchmark metrics by running an evaluator function against target labels and results
review_omol_reducer_class: review the OMolReducer class and its methods for joining, saving, and computing benchmark metrics
